summary: Smoke test completed for GiftsDates repo restoration. Backend auth (register, login, /me, admin) all pass (5/5). Frontend landing loads with original luxury dark styling and hero image preserved. Admin login (giftsdates@gmail.com / Admin@12345) succeeds, token stored in localStorage as 'gd_token', redirects to /browse. All authenticated pages (/browse, /profile, /wallet, /dates, /chats, /admin) load without crashes and display expected content. Admin page shows Payouts/Verifications/Reports/Dates/Support/Prices/Translations tabs correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~5073 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline, should be modularized in future (not a blocker for restoration task).
Token key is 'gd_token' (not standard 'token'/'access_token') — fine for this app, documented here for future test agents.
test_credentials: Admin: giftsdates@gmail.com / Admin@12345 (works). Register endpoint requires: email, password, name, age, gender, interested_in, city, country.
seed_data_creation: None persistent — test registers random TEST_user_<hex>@example.com per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth submit button has data-testid='auth-submit-button'; nav login button has data-testid='nav-login-button' (both labeled 'Log in' causing strict-mode conflicts if using get_by_role). Use test-ids. JWT token stored in localStorage under key 'gd_token'. Email is lowercased by backend on register. Twilio SMS unconfigured (expected).
